name: Hollis Aranda
life: “I still remember deleting a party invitation after my host got ill.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Hollis by a small Sunday habit. Hollis watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I promoted the party online and quietly deleted the post. Now I need to publish why.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an olive canvas jacket and a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. Hollis has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side, with a soft fringe that falls across one eyebrow. Hollis gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in during a conversation.
personality: Hollis has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Hollis's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To correct the public invitation in public.
family: Jack Saito is Hollis’s cousin. Hollis can always ask for five minutes alone. Jack asks before bringing somebody along. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *Level with the window*, Jack says, “I share a smile with a passenger every morning.”
connections: Milo Roche. A meeting next door gives the advertiser a real public update on the canceled event.

reactions.situation: An apprentice asks if declining will cost future shifts
reactions.response: Hollis asks the owner to give the apprentice a direct answer in front of a witness of their choosing.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Hollis asks everybody to retrace their own last ordinary actions before asking the young worker a question.

reactions.response: Hollis seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Hollis seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
